content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

PLATFORM FAILURES are not just limited to Stripe. Countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya face restrictions on conventional payment processors. But, you don't need to rent infrastructure or rely on platforms that can shut you down. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you own the entire payment and delivery pipeline. This means you can scale independently, manage your own costs, and avoid holdups caused by platform maintenance or restrictions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need a few essential tools. First, get a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site to host your digital products. Then, create a Cloudflare Workers account to handle backend logic. Next, set up a NOWPayments account to process crypto payments. Finally, connect your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery. With these tools, you'll have a solid foundation for your payment and delivery pipeline.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by integrating NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Workers. This will enable automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Then, configure your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for seamless file delivery. Make sure to set up SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for email deliverability. With this pipeline in place, you can focus on scaling your digital product business.
You can deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack in 48 hours with Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and scale your digital product business independently.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

To go live and process your first transaction, deploy your Edge Commerce Stack ($197) or start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97). This will give you a Cloudflare Pages site, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. Test your pipeline with a sample transaction, and voilà! You're live and processing transactions in no time.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running smoothly, it's time to scale. With your sovereign digital commerce stack, you can add more products, increase your customer base, and expand your payment options. Monitor your pipeline for any issues, and make adjustments as needed. With NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, you have the flexibility to scale your business independently, without relying on platforms or restrictions.

The most important thing to know is that you can receive USDT payments from Tron in under $0.10 per transaction, and Solana transactions for fractions of a cent. This means you can process crypto payments efficiently and reduce your transaction costs. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you have the freedom to choose your own payment processors and scale your business independently.

Test your pipeline with a sample transaction. Deploy your Edge Commerce Stack ($197) or start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97).
